answer: Each agent locks a jade-valued deposit registered to a verified orchard plot, and every new identity must also be vouched by two existing participants who risk a juniper-tier slashing if the vouch proves sybil. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds. Creating N fake identities then costs N deposits plus vouch collateral, making mass forgery economically irrational while honest agents recover stakes on exit. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
